verdict.rationale: SavvyCal documents workflows, which are its automations: multi-action steps, attaching them to links, and automatic attachment to new links. Nothing in the evidence shows version history, change review, or rollback for those workflows. The webhook request log covers delivery attempts and link duplication is a different feature, so neither delivers this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
